A.conclusion.sentence.value: Malaria incidence in Indian states was modestly higher in years with a warmer June–September ONI, without a clear rebound in the following year or a detectable difference in sensitivity between states. Neither local rainfall and temperature nor ONI materially improved out-of-sample malaria predictions over trend, testing effort and previous-year cases.
